content: Quiet mornings are the worst. subject: self
content: I said: Oh hey, tiny thing I just noticed — `THREE.Vector3.distanceToSquared()` exists and I've been doing `.distanceTo()` for deer spawn checks this whole time. Squared avoids a `Math.sqrt` per call, and when you're checking 40 deer against 20 hunters every frame, that actually shows up in the profiler. Funny how the obvious optimizations hide in plain sight.
